policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O expands partnership with Oracle into ChatGPT
items.summary: O says it’s expanding an Oracle partnership to bring Oracle apps into ChatGPT and related enterprise workflows, positioning it around security and enterprise operations use-cases.

items.headline: O funds academic collaboration on scientific work
items.summary: O describes a collaboration with an academic group, including commitments to make raw data available for verification and to fund a conference on implications.

items.headline: G SEC Form D shows large exempt raise
items.summary: SEC Regulation D notice indicates a completed exempt offering total of $672M and first sale date in June 2026, signaling strong fundraising momentum.

items.headline: V reports multiple spacecraft operating/queued
items.summary: Press reports V is operating two spacecraft in orbit and expects additional launches soon and next year, reflecting expanding capacity for in-space manufacturing tests.

items.headline: O releases GPT-6 for everyone
items.summary: O announces broader rollout of GPT-6 models, including a new GPT-6 model for consumers, tied to ChatGPT usage at scale (weekly users referenced in the post).

items.headline: V announces $251M Series D for orbital pharma
items.summary: V announces a $251M Series D to scale in-space pharmaceutical processing, reporting total capital raised of $598M and naming Lux Capital and Natural Capital as leads.

items.headline: G deprecates G models
items.summary: G updates model deprecations for specific model names, indicating ongoing platform iteration and changes to what developers can call.
